scripts.build:static: node -e "const { GraphService } = require('./functions/lib/graph/graph.service.js'); const { LayoutService } = require('./functions/lib/layout/layout.service.js'); const { LocalJsonFamilyRepository } = require('./functions/lib/repositories/local-json.repository.js'); const fs = require('fs'); const repo = new LocalJsonFamilyRepository(); const graphService = new GraphService(repo); const layoutService = new LayoutService(); Promise.all([graphService.buildFamilyGraph({ lineage: 'konukuru' }).then(g => layoutService.calculateLayout(g, { compactLanes: false })), graphService.buildFamilyGraph({ lineage: 'paradarami' }).then(g => layoutService.calculateLayout(g, { compactLanes: false }))]).then(([konu, para]) => { fs.mkdirSync('./public/data', { recursive: true }); fs.writeFileSync('./public/data/layout-konukuru.json', JSON.stringify(konu, null, 2)); fs.writeFileSync('./public/data/layout-paradarami.json', JSON.stringify(para, null, 2)); });"
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:static && npm run build:client
scripts.test: npm --prefix functions test && npm run test:canvas && npm run test:interaction && npm run test:lineage
